legacy_root.title: workflow-scout executable meta-workflow over the archaeology surface
legacy_root.stopping_expression: all declared source classes searched AND (ranked non-empty OR gap characterised)

tool_policy.title: Tool policy
tool_policy.body: read fixtures and WFA-0019 corpus only; no network; no git write.

roles.title: Scout
roles.body: Walks stages; does not self-certify PASS.

roles.title: Licence verifier
roles.body: Allow-list plus most-restrictive join on COMPOSE.

roles.title: Anti-rebuild gate
roles.body: Stand-in for absent WFA-0120 artifact; same fail-closed citation contract.

stages.title: Ingest typed goal
stages.body: Accept goal text, declared mechanisms, licence_allow, allow_build, source_classes.

stages.title: Fan-out source classes
stages.body: Search registry, repository, marketplace, public-docs, papers, and the live WFA-0019 fixture class. A class with zero hits is a recorded miss, not a skip.

stages.title: Collect hits
stages.body: Enumerate candidate records per class. No network. Fixture archaeology surface only on this worktree.

stages.title: Verify provenance
stages.body: Dereference provenance.src as file:line. The cited line must contain every claimed mechanism id. exists-only is insufficient.

stages.title: Verify licence
stages.body: UNKNOWN licence => UNKNOWN-NEEDS-PROBE, never ranked. Allow-list excludes copyleft when the goal is permissive-only.

stages.title: Decompose mechanisms
stages.body: Score coverage (goal mechanisms present in the candidate) and Jaccard. Rank by independent evidence, not hit frequency.

stages.title: Rank adopt/adapt/compose
stages.body: ADOPT at coverage 1.0, ADAPT at coverage >= 0.5, COMPOSE when two partials union to the goal. Do not pad ranked with below-threshold decoys.

stages.title: Anti-rebuild before BUILD
stages.body: BUILD is considered only if allow_build. The gate cites a verified existing candidate whose coverage of the goal is >= 0.5 and blocks BUILD. A novel goal with no close existing candidate may PASS.

stages.title: Characterise gap
stages.body: If ranked is empty, list missing mechanisms, classes searched, and nearest below-threshold id. Never invent a hit.

stages.title: Emit result
stages.body: Return ranked (each with provenance_anchor and licence_class), unknown_needs_probe, gap, anti_rebuild, optional BUILD.

gates.title: Anti-rebuild
gates.body: Must fire before any BUILD recommendation. Citation is the existing candidate id.

retries.title: Two strikes then pivot
retries.body: After the second identical fingerprint, enumerate two alternatives; do not rebuild ADV.

resume.title: Resume checkpoints
resume.body: Per-source-class hit lists are the resume unit.

dependency_status.WFA-0084: ABSENT on this worktree (no command-center/wfa/WFA-0084-registry-query-interface.json). Scout binds to a typed fixture query surface with the same class/licence/mechanism axes.
dependency_status.WFA-0060: ABSENT on this worktree. Ranking uses coverage of goal mechanisms plus independent provenance, not hit frequency.
dependency_status.WFA-0120: ABSENT on this worktree. Local anti-rebuild gate implements the named contract: reject a planted rebuild and cite the existing id; pass a novel BUILD.

implementation_binding.note: Binding is outside the IR. The IR has no execution entrypoint.

did_not_do: Did not consume a live 284-row Prompt One registry (absent on this Linux worktree).
Did not author WFA-0001 schema pack or WFA-0044 IR-spec.
Did not search a live network marketplace or paper index; papers class is a recorded empty miss.
Did not claim cloud ok=true as delivery.

evidence_requirement.A: end-to-end scout run on goal-e2e-drain returns ranked hits each with provenance_anchor and licence_class
evidence_requirement.B: held-out goal whose known id is wf-heldout-kanban-drain must appear in top ranked results without being named in the goal

evidence.claim: WFA-0127 catalog output_path exists, parses, and is registered as the primary artifact.
WFA-0127 named probes/schema contract were exercised against the live artifact.

reviewer.notes: Envelope repair validated by platform/lib/schema_resolver.py against the catalog output_schema.

residual_unknowns.claim: Independent cross-vendor reviewer of this leftover envelope has not been dispatched.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Dispatch a fresh-context reviewer over the catalog output_path after schema-valid write.
